# unity3d-mcp — Full Reference

## Architecture

FastMCP 3.2 server with dual execution modes. Hands-In mode connects to a running Unity Editor via MCPBridge.cs (TCP port 10835) for live scene manipulation, play-mode control, and viewport captures. Hands-Off mode uses UnityPy (disk-level) for headless imports and batch builds (`-batchmode -quit`).

### Component Managers

- **UnityEditorManager** — Launch, locate, and control Unity Editor instances
- **ProjectManager** — Create, open, configure Unity projects
- **SceneManager** — Scene CRUD, GameObject hierarchy, transforms
- **VRMAvatarManager** — VRM import, humanoid rigging, blend shapes
- **AnimationManager** — Animation clips, controllers, state machines
- **AssetManager** — Package import, texture optimization, asset organization
- **MaterialManager** — Material creation, conversion (built-in ↔ URP ↔ HDRP)
- **BuildManager** — Platform builds, preset management, batch mode
- **PlatformManager** — Multi-platform social VR (VRChat, CVR, Resonite, Cluster)
- **VRChatSDKManager** — VRChat SDK ops, avatar upload, 2FA/TOTP auth

### Observability

- Prometheus metrics on port 9092 (`/metrics`)
- JSON structured logging (UNITY3D_MCP_LOG_FORMAT=json)
- Docker Compose monitoring stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)

## Tools — Full Reference

### unity_bridge (Dual Mode)

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `status` | Bridge connectivity and effective mode |
| `set_execution_mode` | Persist auto/hands_in/hands_off |
| `ensure_gui` | Start/connect Unity Editor bridge |
| `list_objects` | Object tree for active document |
| `screenshot_view` | Capture viewport PNG |
| `execute_script` | Run C# in live Editor context |

### unity_core

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `project_create` | New Unity project with template |
| `project_open` | Open existing project |
| `project_list` | List recent projects |
| `editor_launch` | Launch Unity Editor |
| `editor_quit` | Quit Unity Editor |

### unity_scene

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `create` | New scene |
| `info` | Scene metadata |
| `list_objects` | All GameObjects |
| `create_object` | Instantiate primitive/prefab |
| `delete_object` | Remove GameObject |
| `set_transform` | Set position/rotation/scale |

### unity_render

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `capture` | Single viewport capture |
| `multi_angle` | Multiple camera angles |
| `scene_summary` | Text summary of scene contents |

### unity_avatar

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `import_vrm` | Import VRM avatar |
| `setup_rigging` | Configure humanoid rig |
| `optimize` | Polygon reduction, texture compression |
| `build_vrc_package` | Build VRChat avatar upload package |

### unity_build

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `build` | Build project for target platform |
| `list_presets` | Available build presets |
| `job_status` | Monitor async build progress |

### unity_api (Advanced Editor API)

- `api_execute_method` — Execute Unity C# method with complex parameters
- `api_get_scene_objects` — Full scene object list with components
- `api_modify_object` — Transform/component property modification
- `api_create_prefab` — Create prefab asset from scene object
- `api_run_simulation` — Physics simulation with data recording
- `api_batch_operations` — Batch multiple operations atomically
- `api_move_along_path` — Path animation (straight/bezier/spline/catmull_rom)
- `api_create_path_visualization` — Line/waypoint path visualization
- `api_follow_path_2d` — 2D path with rotation look-ahead
- `api_follow_path_3d` — 3D path with banking angles
- `api_stop_path_movement` — Stop with optional deceleration

Note: API tools are currently scaffolded as "not yet implemented" — they require Unity Editor plugin development.

### Platform Tools

- `list_vr_platforms` — VRChat, CVR, Resonite, Cluster info
- `check_platform_sdk` — SDK presence check by platform
- `check_cck_installed` / `setup_cvr_avatar` / `validate_for_chilloutvr` — CVR flow
- `prepare_for_resonite` / `check_resonite_compatibility` — Resonite flow
- `check_cluster_kit` / `prepare_for_cluster` — Cluster flow

### worldlabs

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `import_marble` | Import Marble 3D world into Unity |
| `assemble_review` | AI-driven review loop for imported worlds |

## HTTP REST API

Served by FastAPI on port 10831 alongside MCP. All endpoints return JSON.

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/health` | Server version, uptime, tool_count, capabilities |
| GET | `/api/v1/status` | Uptime, tool count, Unity Editor detection (running processes, installed versions, project configured) |
| GET | `/api/v1/llm/providers` | Probes Ollama :11434 and LM Studio :1234, returns detected model lists |
| GET | `/api/v1/scene` | Active scenes, full GameObject hierarchy with transforms, components, tags, layers |
| GET | `/api/v1/avatar/status` | VRChat auth status, avatar metrics (polygons, VRAM, draw calls, skinned meshes, dynamic bones, particles), optimization suggestions |
| GET | `/api/v1/packages` | Installed UPM packages with versions, publisher, update status, custom count |
| GET | `/api/v1/editor/scripts` | Available C# snippet library and recent execution history |
| GET | `/api/v1/apps` | Connected app catalog |
| POST | `/api/v1/fleet/launch` | Launch another MCP app via its start.ps1 |
| GET | `/api/v1/workflows` | List available Arazzo mission descriptors |
| GET | `/docs` | FastAPI Swagger UI |

## Config

### Env Vars
- `UNITY_EDITOR_PATH` — Path to Unity Editor executable
- `UNITY_PROJECT_PATH` — Default Unity project directory
- `UNITY3D_MCP_LOG_FORMAT` — "json" for structured logging
- `UNITY3D_MCP_START_METRICS_SERVER` — Enable Prometheus (default true)
- `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` — Comma-separated peer MCP server URLs

### Ports
- 10831 — Backend (REST + MCP SSE)
- 10830 — Frontend (Vite dev dashboard)
- 10835 — MCPBridge.cs TCP (Unity Editor plugin)
- 9092 — Prometheus metrics

## Error Handling

All tools return `{"success": bool, "data": {...}}`. Bridge tools return clear errors when no Unity Editor is connected. API tools return `{"success": false, "error": "Unity Editor API not yet implemented"}` when using scaffolded operations.

## Cross-repo Integration

- **blender-mcp** — GLB/VRM export → unity_import import_blender
- **worldlabs-mcp** — Marble worlds → worldlabs import
- **robotics-mcp** — Vbot spawning in Unity scenes
- **osc-mcp** — VRChat OSC parameter control (moved to separate server)
